# diagrams-site

Covers fenced `mermaid` blocks drawn to SVG at build time: a named flowchart with a narrow layout, a chart without an accessible title (named by its type), a front matter title, a diagram inside a callout, a broken diagram that falls back to its source with the reason, labels and links that try to inject markup, and Obsidian note links, one to a page and one to nothing.

See `basic-site/README.md` for the regeneration procedure.
